caption:
भगवान राम का रोल ऑफर हुआ तो कांप गए थे रणबीर कपूर, मन में बैठ गया था जबरदस्त डर! 😱

फिल्म Ramayana की स्टारकास्ट यानी रणबीर कपूर, साई पल्लवी और रवि दुबे हाल ही में Kaun Banega Crorepati के मंच पर अपनी अपकमिंग फिल्म को प्रमोट करने पहुंचे। 🎬

शो के दौरान अमिताभ बच्चन के पूछने पर रणबीर कपूर ने खुलासा किया कि भगवान राम का रोल मिलने पर उनका पहला रिएक्शन डर था, क्योंकि करोड़ों लोगों की आस्था जुड़ी है। 🌟

रणबीर ने बताया कि यह मौका उन्हें तब मिला जब वह पिता बने थे, और जल्द ही उनका यह डर शुक्रगुजार्री में बदल गया कि वह एक बेहतर इंसान बन सकेंगे। 🙏

साई पल्लवी ने भी बताया कि उन्होंने सीता मां का किरदार निभाने से पहले उनसे प्रार्थना की थी और अपना दिमाग ज्यादा नहीं लगाया। 🌸

यह फिल्म दो भागों में है और इसका पहला पार्ट 5 नवंबर 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगा, जिसमें यश रावण के रोल में हैं। 🎥

तो क्या आप रणबीर कपूर को राम के रूप में देखने के लिए बेताब हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Ranbir Kapoor on KBC says he feared playing Lord Ram in Ramayana when first approached, calls it a ‘big responsibility’
ctx.summary: Ranbir Kapoor said he initially feared he might not be worthy of playing Lord Ram, but that fear soon turned into gratitude.
ctx.text:
The cast of Ramayana — Ranbir Kapoor , Sai Pallavi and Ravie Dubey — appeared on Kaun Banega Crorepati to promote their upcoming film. On the show, Amitabh Bachchan asked the actors about their first instinct when they were approached to play Lord Ram, Sita Maa and Lakshman, respectively. Ranbir admitted that his first instinct was fear, but it soon turned into gratitude.
The makers of Kaun Banega Crorepati have released a new promotional clip from the episode. Speaking about his role, Ranbir said, "When this role was offered to me, I knew that this isn't just a role, it is a big responsibility. My first instinct was fear, that if I am qualified enough to play this role? Whether I will be able to do this role? The faith of crores of people is linked to Lord Shri Ram. But very soon this fear turned into gratitude."
Ranbir admitted that the role came to him around the time he became a father, making the opportunity feel even more special. He added, "I felt gratitude that I got this opportunity at this stage in my life and a chance to become a better human. It was during this time that I became a father and I believe that this film is a God's gift that I got an opportunity to become a better human, to understand Ramayana deeply and to get the opportunity to work with these beautiful people. It not impossible to become like Lord Ram but to learn something from him is a big deal for all of us."
During the show, Sai Pallavi also shared her approach to playing Sita Maa. She revealed that she prayed to Sita Maa before performing the role in the film. She said, "I didn’t want to use my head this time. Every time when I play a character, I think what can I give to that character, but this was the first time when I thought - 'What can I get for playing a role like that of Sita Maa? Like what knowledge will I gain from this?' So, I wanted to keep the process transparent. I didn’t want to think anything about it. I prayed to Sita Maa and went forward with it."
Apart fom Ranbir, Sai Pallavi and Ravie Dubey, it also stars Yash plays Ravana, Sunny Deol as Hanuman, Rajul Preet Singh as Surpanakha and others. It is two-part adaptation of the Hindu epic, with the first part scheduled to release in theatres on November 5, 2026. The film also features music by Hans Zimmer and AR Rahman.
